display.title: The Horizon Gauntlet
description: A Gateways to Eternity trial: 4 fixed waves, fixed enemy counts, a visible timer.
Cost: 1x starforged heart, 2x echoing fossil, 2x skyward plume, 2x honeyed seal (+ ender pearl).
Rewards: affix gear, gems and XP - never relics. Fight it in the open, away from your base.
&7Completes when you are within 48 blocks of the gate as its last wave falls.
